periods.summary: Mrs. Ito is the dominant mother among the new residents around Wakaba House. Her remarks frame the orphanage children as dangerous, uneducated, smelly, poor or thieving, and her influence reaches school and neighborhood life because of her PTA role, family ties to education officials, and her husband's position at Sayama Motors. She deflects responsibility when her son breaks Wakaba House's glass door, insults the children, and later has the boys dump garbage in the yard. Her son's confession reveals the adults' role in the harassment.

key_events.summary: Embodies the prejudice and social power behind the bullying of Wakaba House.
